study_type: Five fresh independent simulated beginners, not a human user study
agent_context: Fresh fork_turns=none tasks; no previous feedback, source code or peer sessions provided
task: Compose a 30-second piece using audio plus MIDI through a VST instrument, save the project and export WAV and MIDI using only a mouse. Give the piece a chosen name if possible.
comparison_note: Core task matches previous rounds. Personalized naming was explicitly encouraged in round2 and round3; elapsed time includes screenshots and reporting pauses and is not a human performance benchmark. Round3 uses the rebased build. Held-gesture driver actions improve observation access and add separate input log events.
inputs: Only screenshots plus logged click, double-click, drag, drag_hold, down, up, scroll and pointer move. No keyboard input, project injection or source inspection during attempt.
reset: Five new native windows on :381–:385, empty caches and fresh working directories. No projects or preferences from prior participants. Settings seed only 48 kHz / 1024 frames. Unmodified production starter audio and byte-identical native Rill Lab Sine VST3.
rating_scale: 1–5; higher means more of the named quality. Higher confusion is worse.
audio: Per-session timer-paced PulseAudio virtual sink via ALSA bridge at48kHz, Rill requested1024 output frames and PULSE_LATENCY_MSEC=60. No physical hardware or listening claims. Shared host, software graphics and virtual backend can affect responsiveness; this is not a latency benchmark.
validation: Independent read-only verification of saved project ZIP, embedded audio, native VST assignment, MIDI events and WAV samples; isolated analysis copies rendered with frozen binary to check actual audio and VST mix contributions. Original outputs remain unmodified.
reporting: Observable action/reaction summaries, screenshots and timestamped mouse logs, not private reasoning transcripts.
frozen_build: Native executable and adjacent plugin helper frozen only after coordinator confirms validation; git HEAD/main, staged+unstaged source diff, untracked source archive, full source hashes and executable hashes recorded.
limitations: No window manager; native dialog placement may differ from desktop installations.
Only the native laboratory sine VST is included; no third-party compatibility claims.
Audible quality is not assessed unless explicitly auditioned and documented.
